problems.why: ek hi IP do ya teen device pe set hai — dono kabhi-kabhi hi jawab denge, jo flaky camera/PLC jaisa dikhta hai. Jaise 192.168.36.31: IP assigned to 3 devices — PLC:Both Karakuri Middle Shelf, PLC:YLM Bending Machi

problems.what: 2 cable aise device se juda hai jo map pe hai hi nahi

problems.what: Aadhe ghante se ek bhi clip archive nahi hui

problems.what: 1 jagah 404 mila

problems.what: 2 endpoint bahut slow hain (10s se upar)
